## Problem and resulting behavior

Describe the concrete problem and how this change addresses it. Link an issue
if applicable. Do not include secrets or real user data.

## Verification

State what ran, its result, and what was not run. Include redacted screenshots
for visible interface changes where useful.

- [ ] Relevant lint, tests, and build checks pass, or exceptions are explained.
- [ ] Any live integration checks used an isolated project and synthetic data.

## Compatibility and release notes

Describe any schema migrations, environment changes, deployment ordering,
rollback limits, or third-party asset/license changes. Write "None" if not applicable.

- [ ] I have the right to contribute the included code/assets under their stated licenses.
- [ ] I checked the diff for credentials, personal data, and unrelated changes.

For a vulnerability, use the private process in SECURITY.md before opening a
public pull request that reveals exploitation details.
